featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Pirates Cafe, Borivali West with family and unfortunately had one of the most disappointing café experiences in recent times.

We ordered Coconut Cream Matcha, Special Thandai Ice Latte Signature, Cold Coffee Signature Tiramisu, Cold Coffee Café Mocha (Cold), Parmesan & Roasted Garlic Fries, along with other beverages. The drinks were average at best, while the fries were decent but nowhere close to compensating for the poor service experience.

The biggest issue was the attitude of the management. We were initially seated in the open-air section and requested a table in the AC section. However, once our order had been placed, there was absolutely no effort from the owners to accommodate the request. It felt as though, after securing the order, customer comfort became irrelevant.

The tables provided were also problematic. Two tables of different dimensions had been joined together, and both were continuously shaking because of uneven bases. Such basic maintenance issues reflect poorly on the attention given to customer experience.

What made the visit even more frustrating was the serving sequence. We ordered multiple beverages and fries together, expecting a family coffee outing where everyone could enjoy their orders at the same time. Instead, every item arrived separately with gaps of around five minutes. By the time the last beverage arrived, the first few drinks had already been consumed. This completely defeated the purpose of visiting a café as a group.

The staff appeared more focused on pleasing the owners than on delivering good customer service. Genuine hospitality was missing, and customer concerns were clearly not a priority.

To add to the irony, a table in the AC section was finally offered only when the last beverage was being served. It came across as artificial courtesy and fake empathy rather than a sincere attempt to resolve the issue.

Overall, an extremely bad experience. There are plenty of cafés that understand customer comfort, service quality, and hospitality far better than this place.

My rating reflects the attitude of the owners towards customers.

Looking at this review and rating, I expect the owners may respond with sympathy and explanations, but what customers need is better service and genuine concern, not post-review damage control.

We ordered quite a spread, starting with the Masala Avocado Toast, which was fresh, flavourful, and perfectly spiced without overpowering the natural taste of avocado. The Raw Papaya & Mango Bhel was a refreshing surprise — a lovely mix of crunch, tang, and sweetness that worked beautifully as a light starter. The Tadka Hummus had a desi twist and paired nicely with the accompaniments. For mains, the Aglio Olio Pasta was comforting, well cooked, and balanced in flavour. To finish, we enjoyed the Tiramisu Coffee and a Classic Cappuccino — both were satisfying and well brewed. We wanted to try their Matcha offerings, but we didn't order once they told us they still don't use Bree Matcha as their source of Matcha & we didn't want to risk having a bad Matcha experience.

Every dish we ordered tasted good, though the serving sizes could definitely be a little more generous, especially considering the pricing. One unique and interesting find was the Ghee Roast Croissant, which stood out for its creativity and flavour.

Seating-wise, the café has a small indoor area that accommodates around 15 people with roughly 6 compact tables, so it can feel a bit tight during peak hours. The outdoor seating is designated for smokers, so it’s best avoided if you’re visiting with kids. The service was prompt and courteous, which added to the overall positive experience.

Unfortunately, we were extremely hungry and only managed to click photos of the avocado toast before everything else arrived! Overall, Cafe Pibati is a great stop for vegetarian food lovers looking for quality food, good coffee, and a cozy café vibe — just with slightly limited seating and portion sizes. ✅☕🥑

featured_reviews.name: Aakash Makwana
featured_reviews.review_text:
02 February 2020 - 13.30 hours

I was recently notified about this place by a few of my friends to try it. I have seen this place from the outside a lot of times but never thought of visiting it. After a few recommendations, tried it. This is located on the main link road in Dahisar west. They have outside and inside seating. I have seen the pics of outside seating at night. It looks beautiful.

We went in noon so chose a place inside in the presence of A.C. I met Naresh who was managing the counter. He was polite and quick. I got to know that this food chain or Tea chain is in business since past almost 4 years and they currently have 4 outlets in Mumbai. Parking could be an issue for a 4-wheeler however you have space for 2-wheelers. So let's see what is good and bad.

Drinks/Beverages

The most popular coffee that almost all recommended was the COLD COFFEE BOURN. This was served in a glass made of glass. It was prepared and decorated like some frappe but it was better. This was a strong coffee mixed with bournvita or something similar. Chocolate powder was sprinkled over the top and on the rim of the glass. A straw is provided with it to slowly take it sip by sip. Considering this coffee being their specialty, the price is quite economical.

After getting impressed by the first item, we order some dishes (discussed later), we wanted something refreshing. We wanted to consume either the watermelon or Green Apple but the machine wasnt working hence we went for FIZZY GUAVA. This was a layered beverage. Here the guava concentrate was settled at the bottom and was mixed with Sprite. It looked beautiful and tasted even better. I thought only mocktails were better with Guava but such soda drinks also go well.

Food

After tasting the legendary Coffee, we were hungry. We scanned and menu and scanner stopped on LOADED FRIES. This was super amazing fries loaded with lots of cheesy sauce, onions, tomato, capsicum and Olives. This was the dish which stayed on our table from start to end (It was that heavy). It can easily serve two. The fries were crisp and perfect in taste too. Olives are love for me so that added to the experience.

Next up was an Indian Italian dish. I mean CLASSIC INDIAN PIZZA. This pizza was a medium pizza with lots of cheese and topped with Onion, tomato, and capsicum. The sauce was the normal pizza sauce and base was a classic pan pizza. It came with oregano and chilli flakes. It was heavy as well and tasted good however I think it could be better. Maybe they can add an option of cheese burst base like other brands.

Another item ordered was Strawberry Milkshake. The ambience was like a regular cafe. This can level up by just adding some music as youth is the prime customer here. Also, the availability of books and board games is a plus. These things can engage you for a long time. I think the quality of chairs can be leveled up. They are too noisy and not to great. Overall a good experience. Must check out if you are around.

featured_reviews.name: Kapil Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Aroma Cafe at The Hive once again, this time with friends, and it reminded us why we were happy to come back. Some places make a good first impression, but only a repeat visit tells you whether they truly maintain their standards. Aroma Cafe did exactly that—with good food, warm hospitality, and a vibe that instantly makes you feel relaxed.
The moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels bright, comfortable, and welcoming. It has that perfect café energy where you can sit for long conversations without feeling rushed. The interiors are pleasant, the seating is comfortable, and the overall ambience carries genuinely good vibes. Whether you’re meeting friends, working for a while, or just taking a break, the place feels easy and enjoyable.
What stood out once again was the hospitality. The staff were polite, attentive, and quick to help whenever needed. They were warm in their interactions and handled the service smoothly, which made our group outing even better. Good hospitality often defines the overall memory of a place, and Aroma Cafe gets this part right.
We ordered quite a spread so everyone could try something different, and the meal turned out to be both satisfying and enjoyable.
Creole Potatoes
A great starter with crispy potatoes tossed in flavourful seasoning. Nicely spiced, crunchy outside, and soft inside—perfect for sharing with friends.
Iced Cold Coffee
Refreshing, smooth, and nicely chilled. It had the right balance of coffee flavour and sweetness, making it ideal for a casual café outing.
Nutella Hot Chocolate
Rich, indulgent, and comforting. The Nutella gave it a creamy hazelnut twist that made it feel more special than a regular hot chocolate.
Veg Alfredo Pasta (Penne) with Extra Cheese Sauce
Creamy, filling, and comforting in every bite. The penne was cooked well, and the extra cheese sauce made it richer and more satisfying.
Coconut Matcha Cloud
A unique and refreshing drink with an interesting flavour combination. The coconut added smoothness while the matcha gave it a light earthy finish.
Mango Smoothie Bowl
Fresh, colourful, and enjoyable. The mango flavour was bright and naturally sweet, making it a lighter and healthier option on the table.
Creamy Garlic Mushroom
Full of flavour and very well prepared. The mushrooms were cooked nicely in a creamy garlic base that was rich without feeling too heavy.
Cheesy Garlic Bread
Warm, cheesy, and hard to resist. Crisp edges with soft bread inside, topped with enough cheese and garlic flavour to make it a crowd favourite.

Veg Spaghetti Aglio Olio Pasta
Simple yet flavourful. The garlic and olive oil coating was balanced, and the spaghetti had a clean, satisfying taste.
What we appreciated most was that despite ordering many different items, the quality remained consistent across the table. Portions were good, presentation was neat, and everything arrived at a comfortable pace. Nothing felt rushed, and we could enjoy the meal while catching up properly.
Another strong point is how suitable the café is for conversations. Some places are either too loud or too formal, but Aroma Cafe strikes a very good middle ground. It feels lively yet peaceful enough to talk comfortably, which is exactly what you want during a friends’ outing.
Cleanliness and upkeep were also impressive. The tables were maintained well, the service area looked organised, and the overall environment felt managed with care.
A repeat visit often comes with higher expectations, and Aroma Cafe lived up to them. Good food, pleasant ambience, and warm service came together once again to create a very enjoyable experience.
Overall, Aroma Cafe at The Hive continues to be a dependable and welcoming place for coffee, comfort food, and quality time with friends. With its good vibes, great hospitality, and consistent food quality, it remains a café we’d happily visit again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxed and enjoyable café experience.
